ingredients.item: Biryani spices (bay leaf, cloves, cardamom, cinnamon)
Red chilli powder, turmeric, garam masala

steps.instruction: In a large bowl, mix chicken with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, red chilli, turmeric, garam masala, half the fried onions, mint, and salt. Marinate for 30 minutes minimum.
steps.safety_tip: Keep raw marinated chicken refrigerated below 4°C until cooking.

steps.instruction: Rinse basmati rice until water runs clear. Boil 6 cups of water with whole spices and salt. Add rice and boil for 5-6 minutes until 70% cooked (grain breaks into 3 parts). Drain completely.
steps.safety_tip: Use a heavy colander and be careful of hot steam when draining.

steps.instruction: In a heavy-bottomed pot, spread marinated chicken as base layer. Layer parboiled rice on top. Garnish with saffron milk, ghee, remaining fried onions, and coriander.
steps.safety_tip: Seal pot edges with dough or tight double aluminum foil to retain aromatic steam.

steps.instruction: Cook on high heat for 5 minutes, then place pot on a heavy tawa and cook on low heat (Dum) for 25 minutes. Rest for 10 minutes before opening.
steps.safety_tip: Check that chicken internal temperature exceeds 74°C (165°F).

steps.instruction: Gently fluff biryani from the bottom using a flat spatula. Serve warm with mint cucumber raita and sliced lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Pan-Seared Salmon with Lemon Herb Garden Salad

ingredients.item: Flaky sea salt & cracked black pepper

steps.instruction: Pat salmon fillets completely dry with a paper towel. Season flesh and skin liberally with sea salt and freshly cracked black pepper.
steps.safety_tip: Dry skin ensures a crisp, golden sear without sticking or oil splatters.

steps.instruction: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a non-stick or cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat. Place salmon skin-side down. Press gently for 10 seconds. Sear undisturbed for 4-5 minutes until skin is crispy.
steps.safety_tip: Do not move the fish until it naturally releases from pan surface.

steps.instruction: Flip fillets carefully and cook for an additional 3-4 minutes until medium-rare to medium. Squeeze half a lemon and add minced garlic in the final 30 seconds.
steps.safety_tip: Salmon should reach an internal temp of 52-60°C (125-140°F) for ideal tenderness.

steps.instruction: In a salad bowl, whisk olive oil, remaining lemon juice, lemon zest, salt, and dill. Toss gently with baby spinach, cucumber slices, and cherry tomatoes.
steps.safety_tip: Wash raw greens thoroughly under clean cold running water.

steps.instruction: Plate a generous bed of dressed greens and place the warm, crisp salmon fillet atop. Garnish with lemon wedges and fresh cracked pepper.
steps.safety_tip: Consume immediately for peak texture contrast.

recipes.title: Tandoori Spiced Paneer Tikka with Mint Dip

ingredients.item: Tandoori masala, chaat masala, kasuri methi

steps.instruction: In a mixing bowl, combine hung curd, roasted besan, mustard oil, ginger-garlic paste, kasuri methi, tandoori masala, and lemon juice until smooth and vibrant orange.
steps.safety_tip: Whisk curd properly so marinade coats evenly without separating.

steps.instruction: Add paneer cubes, bell pepper chunks, and onion petals to marinade. Gently toss. Thread alternately onto wooden or metal skewers.
steps.safety_tip: Soak wooden skewers in water for 20 minutes prior to prevent scorching.

steps.instruction: Preheat oven / air fryer to 200°C (400°F) or grill on a hot stovetop grill pan. Brush lightly with ghee or butter. Cook skewers for 12-14 minutes, rotating halfway for charred edges.
steps.safety_tip: Use heat-resistant tongs and protective oven mitts.

steps.instruction: Sprinkle freshly roasted skewers with chaat masala and fresh cilantro. Serve with cooling mint-coriander yogurt chutney and pickled onions.
steps.safety_tip: Enjoy hot directly off the skewers.

recipes.title: Crispy Tofu & Rainbow Vegetable Stir Fry

ingredients.item: Low sodium soy sauce or tamari

steps.instruction: Toss pressed tofu cubes with cornstarch, salt, and pepper. Heat sesame oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Fry cubes for 6-8 minutes until golden and crispy on all sides. Set aside.
steps.safety_tip: Ensure tofu is thoroughly dried before frying to prevent hot oil splatters.

steps.instruction: In the same wok, toss garlic, ginger, broccoli florets, bell peppers, and snap peas on high heat for 3-4 minutes until tender-crisp.
steps.safety_tip: Maintain constant motion in the wok to prevent garlic from burning.

steps.instruction: Pour low sodium soy sauce and 1 tbsp water into the wok. Return crispy tofu. Toss vigorously for 1 minute until sauce glazes the vegetables and tofu.
steps.safety_tip: Turn off heat promptly to preserve crisp vegetable bite.

steps.instruction: Garnish with toasted white sesame seeds and sliced green scallions. Serve over steamed brown jasmine rice or quinoa.
